newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: YTL down 2.21 pct on Mahathir comments.
newsitem.headline: YTL down 2.21 pct on Mahathir comments.

text.p: Shares in Malaysian private power producer YTL Corp Bhd were down 2.21 percent in morning trade on Friday after comments by Prime Minister Mahathtir Mohamad on Thursday on the power industry, analysts said.
Around 0300 GMT, YTL was off 30 cents to 13.30 ringgit on volume of 259,000 shares.

Mahathir said major contracts would no longer be granted by the government to private power companies known as Independent Power Producers (IPPs). "We have stopped giving to the IPPs now because I think it's Tenaga's turn to expand," Mahathir said after visiting power company Tenaga Nasional Bhd.
Said a trader at a local brokerage house: "The news has dampened sentiment on YTL. Previously investors were buying YTL on the management expertise in getting IPP licences."
The stock of another IPP, Malakoff Bhd, was down 30 cents to 11.10. Power firm Powertek was up five cents to 5.60, while Tenaga rose 20 cents to 10.30.
